title: Choose the visual world for your portfolio
question: The roll assigned the Pattachitra Scroll. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Pattachitra Scroll
options.lineage: Odisha pattachitra cloth scroll painting (Raghurajpur, near Puri)
options.thesis: Your career as a painted Odia scroll: bordered narrative panels, each one a system you shipped, read in sequence like an agent pipeline.
options.viewport: A drenched vermilion field; your name set at wall scale inside a thick patterned border, with the dictation-to-record pipeline shown as the first three panels of the scroll.
options.risk: Reads as decoration if the borders are timid or the tech proof is buried; global recruiters may not know the tradition.

raised.raise: Ma: one panel per scroll is left deliberately empty in charged vermilion, so the dense panels breathe.
Provenance: every metric is stitched to the role and date it came from, never floating free.
Module lock: every panel snaps to one strict border module, so the scroll stays a system at any width.
Scale jumps: type swings from footnote to billboard inside one panel.

options.label: ECG Thermal Printout
options.thesis: The page is a live ECG strip: salmon millimetre grid, black trace, and every project is a waveform segment read out and annotated.
options.viewport: A continuous strip whose trace draws your name, with the header block (name, role, rate) printed like a patient header.
options.risk: The most familiar of these for healthcare tech; clinical grids can feel cold.

options.label: Drum Machine Step Row
options.thesis: Your agent pipeline as a pattern you program: steps are agents, the chase light is execution, and sound is native.
options.viewport: A 16-step row across the full width; pressing run plays the transcribe/extract/validate/format pipeline in tempo.
options.case: Holds product clarity (pipeline = pattern) and fits the sound request; loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Can read as a music toy rather than an engineer.

options.label: ASCII Live Render
options.thesis: Everything rendered in live glyph density; your portrait and the pipeline become text you can select.
options.viewport: A full-grid live render of your name that re-rasterizes under the pointer.
options.case: Engineers identify instantly; loses on clarity for recruiters and clients.
options.risk: Close to the dark-terminal look every dev portfolio ships.

options.label: Ikebana Ma Arrangement
options.viewport: One asymmetric line across empty plaster.
options.case: Too quiet for a bold brief; no tie to the product.
options.kept: Charged empty space as an active element.

options.label: Memory Quilt Atlas
options.thesis: Blocks of worn history seamed together.
options.viewport: A quilt grid of unequal patches.
options.case: Sentimental register fights the engineering proof.

options.label: Modular Colour Bars
options.case: Needs photography that does not exist.
options.kept: A strict module everything snaps to.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern developer portfolio, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name and role, primary CTA, project grid below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other engineer's portfolio by design.
